caseDBIDHint: The Attribute View ID of your test case document library
execDBIDHint: The Attribute View ID of your test execution tracking library. Create it manually: create a Database block, add fields: 用例名称(text), 状态(single-select: 未测试/通过/待修复), 执行日期(date)
pollIntervalHint: How often to check for new documents (1-30s)
excludeKeywordsHint: Comma-separated heading texts that should NOT be treated as test cases (e.g. 正向主流程,异常分支)
autoRecordTimeHint: Automatically fill execution date when status changes to 'Passed' or 'Needs Fix'
clearTimeOnResetHint: Clear the execution date when status is changed back to 'Untested'
parseSkip: Skipped {count} document(s) — already exists in execution database
parseEmpty: No test cases found in the document. Check the heading format.
